# Licences and notices

notdot’s own source and original artwork are licensed under Apache-2.0. The components below retain their own licences; they are not relicensed by notdot.

Original copyright notices and full standard licence terms are retained below. Every declared licence choice is included; the standard texts may contain their original template placeholders. Those placeholders are not new copyright claims. Upstream declarations and copyright lines remain in the original notice files.

The index uses a conservative union of the locked native-app and WASM dependency graphs. Presence here does not claim every source file was linked on every platform. The optional Windows helper belongs to the included shared wake-runtime package.

Source URLs, published revisions, archive checksums and text checksums are in [manifest.json](manifest.json). Package source archives are linked there, including the published MPL-2.0 selectors source. No dependency is relicensed by notdot.
